# testing_unsound_readonly_single_op (Resource)

UnsoundReadonlySingleOp Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_unsound_readonly_single_op" "my_unsoundreadonlysingleop" {
  name = "...my_name..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the resource. Requires replacement if changed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID has x-speakeasy-param-readonly but required as path param in datasource (unsound)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_unsound_readonly_single_op.my_testing_unsound_readonly_single_op
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_unsound_readonly_single_op.my_testing_unsound_readonly_single_op "..."
```
